scoring: Same rules as 14_eval_cortex_analyst.py: numbers within 0.5% relative; first_row=True means the first expected row must appear in the analyst's first row; percent_ok=True accepts a share as a fraction or a percentage.
truth_cte:
WITH ds AS (
    SELECT * FROM VALUES
        ('FD001', 'Single', 'HPC degradation'),
        ('FD002', 'Six', 'HPC degradation'),
        ('FD003', 'Single', 'HPC and fan degradation'),
        ('FD004', 'Six', 'HPC and fan degradation') AS v(dataset, conditions, faults)
),
eng AS (
    SELECT t.dataset, t.engine_id, MAX(t.cycle) AS life, ds.conditions, ds.faults
    FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.STAGING.STG_TELEMETRY t JOIN ds USING (dataset)
    GROUP BY t.dataset, t.engine_id, ds.conditions, ds.faults
),
cyc AS (
    SELECT t.*, MAX(t.cycle) OVER (PARTITION BY t.engine_id) - t.cycle AS rul, ds.conditions, ds.faults
    FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.STAGING.STG_TELEMETRY t JOIN ds USING (dataset)
)

cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD001'

cases.q: T50 degradation for FD004?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD004'

cases.q: Show LPT temperature rise to failure by fault mode.
cases.truth: SELECT faults, AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc GROUP BY 1

cases.q: For the single-condition datasets, what's the T50 rise before failure in each?
cases.truth: SELECT dataset, AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE conditions = 'Single' GROUP BY 1

cases.q: For FD001, give both the HPC and LPT temperature rise to failure.
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)), AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD001'

cases.q: Show T30 and T50 rise to failure side by side for every dataset.
cases.truth: SELECT dataset, AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)), AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc GROUP BY 1

cases.q: In FD003, what's the average T30 in the baseline window versus the critical action window?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)), AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD003'

cases.q: For FD001 engines that lasted more than 200 cycles, how much did T30 rise before failure?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD001' AND engine_id IN (SELECT engine_id FROM eng WHERE life > 200)

cases.q: How many more cycles do FD003 engines last on average compared to FD001?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(dataset = 'FD003', life, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(dataset = 'FD001', life, NULL)) FROM eng

cases.q: What's the difference in MTTF between fan-and-HPC degradation and HPC-only degradation?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(faults = 'HPC and fan degradation', life, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(faults = 'HPC degradation', life, NULL)) FROM eng

cases.q: By how many cycles does MTTF differ between six-condition and single-condition fleets (six minus single)?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(conditions = 'Six', life, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(conditions = 'Single', life, NULL)) FROM eng

cases.q: How many times more cycles did FD002 fly than FD001?
cases.truth: SELECT COUNT_IF(dataset = 'FD002') / COUNT_IF(dataset = 'FD001') FROM cyc

cases.q: What share of all engines belong to FD004?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(dataset = 'FD004', 1, 0)) FROM eng

cases.q: Compare MTTF of FD001 and FD003.
cases.truth: SELECT dataset, AVG(life) FROM eng WHERE dataset IN ('FD001', 'FD003') GROUP BY 1

cases.q: Mean life in FD002 versus FD004?
cases.truth: SELECT dataset, AVG(life) FROM eng WHERE dataset IN ('FD002', 'FD004') GROUP BY 1

cases.q: Is the fleet's median life above or below its mean? Give median minus mean.
cases.truth: SELECT MEDIAN(life) - AVG(life) FROM eng

cases.q: How much larger is FD003's T30 rise to failure than FD001's?
cases.truth: SELECT (SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD003') - (SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(cycle <= 20, hpc_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD001')

cases.q: What percentage of all operating cycles came from each dataset?
cases.truth: SELECT dataset, COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () FROM cyc GROUP BY 1

cases.q: In FD001, how much hotter is T50 in the critical window than in the healthy stage?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(rul <= 15, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) - AVG(IFF(rul > 50, lpt_outlet_temp, NULL)) FROM cyc WHERE dataset = 'FD001'

cases.q: Which datasets have an MTTF above 200 cycles?
cases.truth: SELECT dataset FROM eng GROUP BY 1 HAVING AVG(life) > 200

cases.q: For each fault mode, show the number of engines and the total cycles flown.
cases.truth: SELECT e.faults, e.n, c.n FROM (SELECT faults, COUNT(*) n FROM eng GROUP BY 1) e JOIN (SELECT faults, COUNT(*) n FROM cyc GROUP BY 1) c USING (faults)

cases.q: How many cycles longer did the longest-lived engine run than FD004's mean life?
cases.truth: SELECT MAX(life) - AVG(IFF(dataset = 'FD004', life, NULL)) FROM eng

cases.q: What's the ratio of six-condition MTTF to single-condition MTTF?
cases.truth: SELECT AVG(IFF(conditions = 'Six', life, NULL)) / AVG(IFF(conditions = 'Single', life, NULL)) FROM eng
